name: Human tonsil, PhenoCycler 19-plex
description: Akoya PhenoCycler-Fusion scan of two FFPE human tonsil sections, stained with fresh (top) and lyophilized (bottom) antibodies, with 18 markers and DAPI, read directly from a 13 GB QPTIFF; opens on CD3 (T cells), CD20 (B cells), and Ki-67 (dividing cells).

source.citation: Lee JL et al. (2025) Large-scale quantitative assessment of tissue preparation and staining conditions for robust multiplexed imaging of FFPE tissue samples. BioImage Archive. doi:10.6019/S-BIAD2491
